sections.title: Active manuscripts
sections.sql: select code,title,editor,status,round,overdue_days,eligible_reviews,review_target from editorial_queue where status in ('triage','review','revision') order by overdue_days desc,code

sections.title: Review chase
sections.sql: select manuscript,reviewer,status,due_on,overdue_days from review_chase order by overdue_days desc

sections.title: Evidence checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,record

sections.title: Assignments
sections.sql: select code,name,specialty,capacity,active_reviews,overdue_reviews,over_capacity from reviewer_load order by active_reviews desc,code
